Arabian Sea

solution:
The correct answer is __**i-c, ii-a, iii-d, iv-b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Cyclone Tauktae:

 
 
• ​It was the first cyclonic storm of 2021 that emerged from the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• It hit southern **Gujarat** on **17 May 2021** and was classified as a **Very Severe Cyclonic Storm** (VSCS).
 
• It is a tropical cyclone, It has been named by Myanmar. It means 'gecko', a highly vocal lizard, in the Burmese language.
 
 
 
• Cyclone Yaas:
 
 
• The cyclonic storm, Cyclone Yaas, formed in the** Bay of Bengal **and hit West Bengal and adjoining Odisha coasts in **May 2021**.
 
• The name of the cyclone is given by Oman. ​
 
 
 
• Hurricane Katrina:
 
 
• **Hurricane Katrina** formed from the combination of a** tropical wave** and the **remnants of Tropical Depression** Ten as a tropical depression on **23 August 2005**.
 
• A hurricane is a tropical cyclone centered in the **Atlantic Ocean.**
 
 
 
• **Hurricane Ingrid:**
 
 
• **Hurricane **​Ingrid was a **category 1 hurricane** (on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale) over the southwestern **Gulf of Mexico** that made landfall as a tropical storm in northeastern Mexico.
 
• In combination with Eastern Pacific **Hurricane Manuel**, it caused widespread flooding and many casualties in Mexico.**​**
 
• Tropical cyclones Ingrid and Manual hit almost simultaneously the **Atlantic and Pacific coasts of Mexico** respectively from **12 to 17 Sep 2013**.
